name: Figma
description: Figma's hosted server gives the agent the structure of a frame — layout, variables, components and Code Connect mappings — so code follows the design instead of a screenshot.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (api.figma.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
